stories.title: Implement CQT + Hotelling T² crossfade detector
acceptanceCriteria: Uses CQT decomposition (K=8 constant-Q bands), not octave filterbank
Uses Hotelling T² test on PSD vectors (5s windows, 1s hop)
uv run python detector.py <test_wav> runs without error

stories.title: Combine phase detector + crossfade detector
acceptanceCriteria: detect_splices(audio, sr) runs BOTH phase and crossfade detection
Results are merged and deduplicated (within 1s = same detection)
Each detection tagged with method: 'phase' or 'psd_changepoint'
prepare.py evaluates combined detector and prints splice_f1

stories.title: Achieve F1 improvement on crossfade test files
acceptanceCriteria: At least 1 Tier 2 crossfade splice detected (TP > 0 on tier2 files)
Tier 1 recall does not regress below 4/6
